assumptions: Card Game is not registered; a minimal deterministic duel proxy is provided for interface work only.
Demo cards/effects are placeholders, not an inferred game specification.
Snapshot reveals public health, mana, phase and zone counts only; deck order and both private hands are excluded.
The active player sees their own hand in the visual surface, not through the candidate snapshot or text observer.

Kept private hand/deck contents out of snapshots, normalized public lowercase phase actions, and exposed live same-instance acceptance hooks. Delayed policy execution remains an external wrapper boundary.

visibleActions() returns a deep copy of the most recently rendered current-player play labels plus the visible Pass affordance; it reads no private game state and exposes no opponent hand or future deck.

visibleState() returns only tick, active_player, mana, own health, and opponent health from the last successfully rendered HUD, relative to the acting player. The getter returns only the cached projection.
